title: fsl_motion_outliers
description: FSL tool used to calculate motion outliers in 4D image data

mask_image.description: Use supplied mask image for calculating metric
mask_image.title: Mask image

save_metric_file.description: Save metric values (e.g. DVARS) as text into specified file
save_metric_file.title: Save metric file

save_metric_plot.description: Save metric values (e.g. DVARS) as a graphical plot (png format)
save_metric_plot.title: Save metric plot

temp_path.description: [Optional] Path to the location where temporary files should be created. Defaults to /tmp
temp_path.title: Temporary files path

refrms_flag.description: Use RMS intensity difference to reference volume as metric
refrms_flag.title: Reference RMS flag

refmse_flag.description: Mean Square Error version of --refrms (used in original version of fsl_motion_outliers)
refmse_flag.title: Reference MSE flag

fdrms_flag.description: Use FD with RMS matrix calculation as metric
fdrms_flag.title: FD RMS flag

abs_thresh.description: Specify absolute threshold value (otherwise use box-plot cutoff = P75 + 1.5*IQR)
abs_thresh.title: Absolute threshold

no_moco_flag.description: Do not run motion correction (assumed already done)
no_moco_flag.title: No motion correction flag

dummy_scans.description: Specify number of dummy scans to delete (before running anything and creating EVs)
dummy_scans.title: Number of dummy scans
